## Summary

Describe the problem and the focused change that addresses it.

## Validation

List the commands and manual checks you ran.

## Checklist

- [ ] I added or updated tests for behavior changes.
- [ ] I updated public documentation when the interface or workflow changed.
- [ ] I ran `pnpm check`.
- [ ] I ran `pnpm test:theme-check` for Liquid or theme changes.
- [ ] I removed store domains, credentials, customer data, and other sensitive information.
